text: The report regards its finding of phylogenetic dominance of gene-content similarity as consistent with Garud et al. (2019) and Shapiro et al. (2012), described as showing that clonal ancestry shapes genome-wide variation more than ecological niche.

text: The report relates weak environmental gene-content effects to Polz et al. (2013), described as arguing that horizontal gene transfer shapes population structure at specific loci rather than genome-wide.

text: AlphaEarth embeddings have only 28.4% genome coverage in the report, limiting the environmental signal available for analysis.
quote: AlphaEarth embeddings have only 28.4% genome coverage, limiting the environmental signal available for analysis.
heading: Limitations

text: Missing or imprecise geographic coordinates in NCBI metadata reduce the quality of environmental associations in the ecotype analysis.
quote: Geographic coordinates from NCBI metadata are often missing or imprecise, reducing the quality of environmental associations.
heading: Limitations

text: The report cautions that partial correlations assume linear relationships between distance matrices and may miss nonlinear ecological effects.
quote: Partial correlations assume linear relationships between distance matrices, which may not capture nonlinear ecological effects.
heading: Limitations

text: For host-associated organisms, reported geographic coordinates reflect collection sites rather than actual microenvironments, making latitude and longitude less meaningful.
quote: Host-associated organisms have less meaningful lat/lon data, as the reported coordinates reflect collection site rather than the organism's actual microenvironment.
heading: Limitations
